description: Return the public key that verifies the signed visitor identity (the X-Cruma-Identity header) this agent passes to backends of sign-in-protected hostnames: the current key and, for ten minutes after a rotation, the previous one, each with its kid, algorithm, JWK `x` and PEM, plus the JWKS path every protected hostname serves them at. Public data only; the agent never reveals the private key. Rotate it with `cruma auth identity-key --rotate` or in the desktop app.
name: get_identity_key
